review_notes: All 6 modules audited (776 lines total). Source code (__init__.py, base.py, config.py, docker_sandbox.py, egress.py = 258 lines) is clean: stdlib dataclasses/abc already used, Docker SDK already handles container orchestration, urlparse-based egress matching is minimal. No library dependency would reduce the source. All 67 eliminable lines are in the test file (518 lines): 5 tests re-test stdlib behavior (Q1, 41 lines) and 4 tests are duplicative or trivial (Q3, 26 lines). One source defect noted but not counted: EgressPolicy allowlist is logged twice (egress.py:34 and docker_sandbox.py:29) because DockerSandbox.__init__ redundantly calls log_allowlist() after EgressPolicy.__init__ already logged; remove the redundant call. Total reduction 67 lines, well above the 20-line threshold. No git used.
